question: Will Meta (META) beat consensus EPS earnings on July 29, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) reports Q2 2026 GAAP diluted EPS that exceeds the Wall Street consensus GAAP diluted EPS estimate at the time of the July 29, 2026 earnings release.
- "No": Wins if Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) reports Q2 2026 GAAP diluted EPS that meets or falls below the Wall Street consensus GAAP diluted EPS estimate at the time of the July 29, 2026 earnings release.

Clarifications:
- The EPS figure used for comparison is Meta's reported GAAP diluted EPS for Q2 2026, as disclosed in the official earnings release on July 29, 2026.
- The consensus EPS estimate used for comparison is the Wall Street analyst consensus (mean or median, per the data provider's standard methodology) as of market close on July 29, 2026, prior to the earnings release.
- GAAP diluted EPS is the operative figure for both the reported result and the consensus benchmark.
